goal: Produce traceable, human-directed, production-ready creative artifacts without silently changing source facts, approved decisions, or scope.

stages.name: strategy
stages.goal: Convert customer and project inputs into an approved authoritative project definition.
stages.memory_effect: Creates approved project knowledge; never creates external source facts.

stages.name: research
stages.goal: Establish traceable audience, market, cultural, and visual-reference evidence.
stages.memory_effect: Adds sourced project and external evidence; unsupported conclusions remain UNKNOWN.

stages.name: visual_analysis
stages.goal: Describe supplied visual evidence without turning observations into creative decisions.
stages.memory_effect: Creates project-reference observations classified as SOURCE or DERIVED.

stages.name: named_style_study
stages.goal: Understand a named visual language and derive responsible transferable principles.
stages.memory_effect: Adds source-backed style knowledge; interpretation cannot become historical fact.

stages.name: motif_sign_extraction
stages.goal: Extract recurring visual vocabulary while preserving evidence, frequency, and imitation risk.
stages.memory_effect: Creates scoped motif records; motifs remain evidence, not brand decisions.

stages.name: reference_style_synthesis
stages.goal: Translate supplied references and applicable style knowledge into original transferable principles.
stages.memory_effect: Creates project-scoped derived creative knowledge with explicit provenance.

stages.name: visual_dna
stages.goal: Convert validated evidence and style principles into traceable visual-system rules.
stages.memory_effect: Creates candidate project rules; approval scope must remain explicit.

stages.name: platform_template_synthesis
stages.goal: Translate the approved visual system into reusable platform-specific production structure.
stages.memory_effect: Creates reusable structure only; campaign content and old project assumptions cannot transfer.

stages.name: art_direction
stages.goal: Create and approve content-specific creative decisions within strategy and visual-system constraints.
stages.memory_effect: Creates approved creative decisions; decisions remain distinct from evidence.

stages.name: generation
stages.goal: Operationalize approved direction into an execution specification and model-adapted prompt.
stages.memory_effect: Creates OUTPUT artifacts only; a generated result is not automatically knowledge or a requirement.

stages.name: content_package
stages.goal: Assemble the complete publishable content artifact without introducing new strategic claims.
stages.memory_effect: Records the content instance and its approved relationships to template and style artifacts.

stages.name: human_revision_style_learning
stages.goal: Apply scoped human changes and promote only approved, traceable patterns into reusable memory.
stages.memory_effect: May create project references or rules; system promotion requires explicit human authority and evidence.

stages.name: editable_reconstruction_preparation
stages.goal: Prepare a flattened approved visual for faithful editable reconstruction while preserving source lock.
stages.memory_effect: Records reconstruction derivations without replacing the approved visual as source evidence.

stages.name: figma_implementation
stages.goal: Build and validate the approved design as a structured editable production master.
stages.memory_effect: Records implementation provenance; production reconstruction cannot silently redefine art direction.

stages.name: quality_control_final_approval
stages.goal: Evaluate the complete production result, diagnose root cause, and approve or route correction.
stages.memory_effect: Records quality evidence and revision routing; scores cannot override critical failures.
